plastic_bottle.reasoning: PET/HDPE plastic bottles are recyclable. Empty and rinse before recycling.

can.reasoning: Aluminum and steel cans are recyclable. Rinse before recycling.

paper_cup.reasoning: Most paper cups have a plastic lining and cannot be recycled.

plastic_cup.reasoning: Disposable plastic cups are generally not recyclable.

glass_bottle.reasoning: Glass bottles are recyclable. Rinse before recycling.
glass_bottle.preAction: Rinse and remove cap if different material

cardboard.reasoning: Cardboard is recyclable. Flatten before recycling.
cardboard.preAction: Flatten and remove tape if possible

food_waste.reasoning: Food scraps and leftovers are compostable.

plastic_bag.reasoning: Plastic bags jam sorting machinery. Some grocery stores accept them for separate recycling.

plastic_container.reasoning: Most rigid plastic containers (#1-#5) are recyclable. Rinse before recycling.

battery.reasoning: Batteries contain hazardous materials and require special disposal.
battery.preAction: Take to a battery collection point

styrofoam.reasoning: Expanded polystyrene is not accepted in most recycling programs.
